New task:
You are a financial analysis assistant.

Scenario
You are reading a section of a company’s annual report that discusses changes in costs, revenues and taxes over several years.  The passage explains increases in cost of revenues, depreciation, exploration expenses, interest, minority interest, and—in particular—income-tax related items.  It emphasises that the effective income-tax rate for continuing operations changed from 2004 through 2006 owing to factors such as foreign operations, state and local taxes and other tax effects.

Tools you can call
• list_available_rate_types() → List[str]
  Return every rate-type code stored in the finance database.
• get_rate_type_description(rate_type_code: str) → str
  Human-readable description for a given rate-type code.
• list_years_for_rate_type(rate_type_code: str) → List[int]
  All calendar years that contain an entry for the specified rate type.
• get_effective_rate(rate_type_code: str, year: int) → float
  Numeric effective tax-rate percentage for the chosen rate type and year.
• list_component_names() → List[str]
  List of all component names that make up a tax rate.
• get_component_rate(component_name: str, year: int) → float
  Percentage value of a single component in a given year.
• compute_effective_rate_from_components(year: int) → float
  Sum of all component rates for the year (rounded to one decimal).
• get_average_effective_rate(start_year: int, end_year: int, rate_type_code: str) → float
  Mean effective rate over the inclusive year range.
• get_max_effective_rate(rate_type_code: str) → (int, float)
  Year and value at which the effective rate peaks for the given type.

Question
By how much did the effective income tax rate for continuing operations increase from 2005 to 2006?

Please think step-by-step, call whichever tools you need, and output the final numeric increase followed by a percent sign (e.g. "8.5%") so that your answer can be automatically checked.
